item.title: WVC BOYS’ BASKETBALL: Cougars hang on to edge Wolfpack
item.description: HAZLE TWP. — The Wilkes-Barre Area and Hazleton Area boys’ basketball teams once again clung to one another like lint on a sweater, Thursday. Considering seven of the teams’ eight previous meetings over the past three seasons were decided by six points or fewer and the other went into overtime, another close game between the two was hardly a surprise.
